text: The authors assume they are given a logical consistency function c(x_i, y_i, x_j, y_j) in {0, 1} that checks whether labels on two data points are logically consistent, and use it to count inconsistencies in the label set so as to rule out degenerate solutions of maximizing mutual predictability alone.
title: Assumption: a logical consistency function between label pairs is given
